ledger.x: 10 September 1943: Germany sets up the Operational Zone of the Adriatic Littoral.
10 September 1943: the zone is attached to the Gau of Carinthia.
2 May 1945: the German units in the zone surrender.
May 1945: the Operational Zone of the Adriatic Littoral ends.

certainty.note: The zone is defined by named Italian provinces, whose boundaries were fixed; the lines of the Pula, Rijeka and Ljubljana provinces are not given on the page.
